name: Sousei Seiki Devadasy
original_name: 創世聖紀デヴァダシー
source:
A boy rides a giant robot powered by sexual energy to protect the world with six girls.

This game has been animated as an OVA, but the animation seems to only cover the first part of the game.
translation:
一名男孩骑着一个由性能量驱动的巨型机器人，与六名女孩一起保护世界。

该游戏已被动画化为OVA，但动画似乎只涵盖了游戏的第一部分。
